FORM.notes: source note: s<m>anis=iku tu penina: 我削香蕉樹皮

S.FORM: A XXXX temawaR si a anu qumni yau dawadsu si sanisika ya peninaku yau peninaku mwaza.
S.PHON: a **** təmawaʁ si a anu qumni jau ɮawaɮsu si sanisika ja pəninaku jau pəninaku mwa[z|r]a
S.FORM: A XXXX temawaR si a anu qumni yau dawadsu si sanisika ya peninaku yau peninaku mwaza.
S.PHON: a **** təmawaʁ si a anu qumni jau ɮawaɮsu si sanisika ja pəninaku jau pəninaku mwa[z|r]a
S.TRANSL: 如果你明天有空的話,來削我的香蕉樹皮.我有很多香蕉樹皮.
If you have time tomorrow, bark my banana trees. I have much banana bark.

S.FORM: I XXXX XXXX A nengi nayaupaita I XXXX A nayawpaita.
S.PHON: i **** **** a nəŋi najaupaita i **** a najawpaita
S.FORM: I XXXX XXXX A nengi nayaupaita I XXXX A nayawpaita.
S.PHON: i **** **** a nəŋi najaupaita i **** a najawpaita

S.FORM: I nayauakita sikawma si mana azu.
S.PHON: i najauakita sikawma si mana a[z|r]u
S.FORM: I nayauakita sikawma si mana azu.
S.PHON: i najauakita sikawma si mana a[z|r]u

S.TRANSL: 我說讓你削樹皮,(你要做也可以不要做也可以).
'Bark (the banana trees),' said I. (It's up to you.)

S.FORM: A m nayau I nengipaisu qaya.
S.PHON: a m najau i nəŋipaisu qaja
S.FORM: A m nayau I nengipaisu qaya.
S.PHON: a m najau i nəŋipaisu qaja
S.TRANSL: Yes, good. You will also do so.
It would be better (if we wait till) the athletic meet is over.

S.FORM: A nayauikati ya I XXXX sanis.
A nayauikati ya I XXXX sanis.
XXXX A naquni si yau dawadsu si sanisika ya peninaku haw.
S.PHON: **** a naquni si jau ɮawaɮsu si sanisika ja pəninaku haw
S.FORM: XXXX A naquni si yau dawadsu si sanisika ya peninaku haw.
S.PHON: **** a naquni si jau ɮawaɮsu si sanisika ja pəninaku haw
S.TRANSL: 這樣的話,你有空的話,來削我的香蕉樹皮.
If so, if you have time, bark my banana trees.

S.FORM: A n nayauantati sanisika zinkuisu nani.
A n nayauantati sanisika zinkuisu nani.
S.TRANSL: 嗯,那我們就那樣做,我跟你說,'削樹皮'.
Okay, let's do so. 'Bark banana trees,' I said to you.
You have to respond to me in this way.

S.FORM: A n I maiti yaupama mgaysyawholi.
S.PHON: a n i maiti jaupama mgajsjawh*ri
S.FORM: A n I maiti yaupama mgaysyawholi.
S.PHON: a n i maiti jaupama mgajsjawh*ri
S.TRANSL: 沒有了嗎?還有沒有?介紹給你.
Finished? Anything else? Let me introduce to you.

FORM.notes: source note: IU47為發音人回覆錄音者的話,非對話本身的內容

S.TRANSL: 你開始(削香蕉樹皮)了嗎?
Have you started (barking the banana trees)?
還沒,還沒有開始(削香蕉樹皮).
Not yet. (I) haven't begun (barking the banana trees).
